Introduction
This document 
 outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be carried out on yearly 
 bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Technical
Specifications:

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Wael Ahmed Omar, tested by eng. Tarek Ebrahim Hassan, accepted by general 
 manager Mosatfa Abd El-Sattar El-Kalmoushy, approved by eng. Ebrahim Mahmoud 
 Aly Hassan Head Sector of Talkha Power Station, revised by eng. Adel Abdel 
 Qader Al- Nagar MDEPC quality control engineer, certified by eng: Samir Abdel 
 Gilel MDEPC Inspection and Quality Control General Director &MPIS 
 Coordinator, approved by eng: Mohamed Nageb 
 : MDEPC Inspection &Quality Control Head Sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must 
 be issued.
The unit must be 
 out of service.
The maintenance 
 staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety 
 category.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and 
 healthy equipments.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete tool set
Digital voltmeter.
Vacuum cleaner.
Work to be 
carried out
Visual inspection of the condition of:
External 
 screwed fittings
Operating 
 linkage
External 
 connections
Check for 
 corrosion
Visual and manual inspection of the condition of all wiring.
Check 
 all terminal boxes.
Check 
 the circuit and connection points by continuity method.
Miscellaneous checks:
Read and record the 
 operations counter P1(Fig 1) of the three-pole circuit-breaker Q0.
Read and record of pump start-up 
 counter P2(Fig 1) of drive.
Check for correct function of the 
 various heaters
Investigate 
 for unexplainable noises and smells.
Check regularly the 
 circuit-breaker SF6 gas pressure.
The pressure 
gauge serves only for visual monitoring of the SF6 gas pressure.
